sources.title: IBM i 7.6 — Password control (GO SECURITY paths)
SecureMyi — GO SECURITY user class visibility
IBM i Security reference — commands and menus appendix

asciiPanel:
SECSTOCK                         IBM i Security Paths                    CLAIMS400

Select one of the following:
 1. Change your password
 2. Work with authorization lists
 3. Work with security auditing
 4. Work with user profiles
20. Work with system values

90. Sign off

Selection or command
===>
F3=Exit   F12=Cancel
notes: Lab GO SECSTOCK training hub (expanded SECURITY paths from SECURITY option 20). Stock IBM GO SECURITY (QSYS/SECURITY) shows 8 different options — see security.golden.json: stock has '2. Work with user profiles', '3. Work with authorization lists', '5. Work with security auditing', '8. Security tools'; lab SECSTOCK renumbers and adds governance paths (inactive profiles, privileged session, CHGACTPRFL, SECTOOLS concept). *USER class on stock system sees only option 1.
